name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

overview: A flagship mission to provide central assistance to eligible urban poor and middle-class families to construct, purchase or rent affordable pucca houses over five years from 2024 to 2029.
objectives: Provide housing for all in urban areas
Address housing needs of EWS, LIG and MIG families
Promote affordable rental and beneficiary-led construction

benefits.title: Central Assistance
benefits.description: Government assistance of up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per housing unit

otherCriteria: Families with no pucca house anywhere in India; covers EWS, LIG and MIG segments in urban areas

applicationProcess.description: Apply online or through Urban Local Body

faqs.question: What is the assistance amount?
faqs.answer: Up to Rs. 2.50 lakh per beneficiary depending on the housing verticals.

faqs.question: Who is eligible?
faqs.answer: EWS/LIG/MIG urban families without a pucca house anywhere in India.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
overview: A scheme to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to all houseless and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
objectives: Provide pucca houses to eligible rural households
Improve housing conditions for the rural poor
Convergence with other schemes for toilets, electricity and LPG connections

benefits.title: Financial Assistance
benefits.description: Unit assistance of Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas/IAP districts

otherCriteria: Houseless households and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses as per Socio Economic Caste Census/Awaas+ survey

applicationProcess.description: Assistance released in installments linked to construction stages

faqs.question: How is the beneficiary list prepared?
faqs.answer: Based on the SECC 2011 data validated by the Gram Sabha and updated through the Awaas+ survey.

faqs.question: What is the unit assistance amount?
faqs.answer: Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs. 1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas.

name: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

overview: A sub-scheme under PMAY-Urban to provide ease of living to urban migrants and poor by offering affordable rental housing near their workplace.
objectives: Provide affordable rental housing to urban migrants and poor
Encourage private participation in rental housing

benefits.title: Affordable Rent
benefits.description: Access to livable rental units at affordable rates close to workplaces

otherCriteria: Urban migrants/poor including labourers, students and industrial workers

customQuestions.question: Are you an urban resident or an urban migrant?
Do you belong to the EWS or LIG category?  EWS / LIG  Yes  3  Do you currently require affordable rental accommodation?

Are you an urban migrant/poor person or part of an eligible target group such as an industrial worker, construction worker, working woman, street vendor, rickshaw puller, service provider, student, contractual worker, etc.?
Are you willing to rent and reside in an ARHC unit under the applicable rental terms?

applicationProcess.description: Existing government-funded vacant houses converted into ARHCs by concessionaire
Eligible beneficiaries apply through the concessionaire or ULB

faqs.question: Who can rent under ARHC?
faqs.answer: Urban migrant labourers, poor, students, and other eligible categories.

faqs.question: Is ARHC a separate scheme?
faqs.answer: It is a sub-scheme under PMAY-Urban.

name: PMAY-U 2.0 Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

overview: A vertical under PMAY-Urban 2.0 providing interest subsidy on home loans to EWS/LIG/MIG families to enable them to buy or construct their first house.
objectives: Reduce effective home loan interest burden for eligible families

benefits.title: Interest Subsidy
benefits.description: Subsidy on interest paid on home loans for construction/purchase of house, credited upfront to loan account

otherCriteria: Families availing a home loan for their first pucca house with no other pucca house in the family

applicationProcess.description: Apply for a home loan from a participating lending institution
Lending institution verifies eligibility under PMAY-U 2.0
Interest subsidy credited to the borrower's loan account

faqs.question: How is the subsidy disbursed?
faqs.answer: Directly credited to the beneficiary's loan account by the lending institution.

faqs.question: Can I avail this along with other PMAY-U verticals?
faqs.answer: No, a beneficiary can avail benefit under only one vertical of PMAY-U 2.0.

name: DAY-NULM Shelter for Urban Homeless (SUH)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission

overview: A component of DAY-NULM providing permanent all-weather shelters with essential services to urban homeless persons and vulnerable populations.
objectives: Provide shelter with basic services to the urban homeless
Facilitate access to entitlements and social security for shelter residents
Enable rehabilitation and livelihood linkage for the homeless

benefits.title: Free Shelter
benefits.description: Access to a permanent all-weather shelter with bedding, drinking water and sanitation

otherCriteria: Urban homeless persons including migrants, destitute and vulnerable individuals

customQuestions.question: Are you currently homeless?
Are you residing in or seeking shelter in an urban area?

Are you willing to stay in a designated SUH shelter?
Are you a single homeless person, homeless family, elderly person, person with disability, mentally ill/recovering person, or another vulnerable homeless person?
Are you willing to follow the rules and conditions of the shelter?

applicationProcess.description: Approach the nearest shelter run under DAY-NULM SUH
Access shelter along with linked welfare services

faqs.question: Is there any cost to stay in the shelter?
faqs.answer: No, shelters under SUH are provided free of cost.

faqs.question: Who manages the shelters?
faqs.answer: Urban Local Bodies, often through NGOs/partner agencies.
